verdict: Nasi kerabu is slightly better. It's lower in calories, higher in protein, and has ulam that keeps you fuller.
why: Nasi kerabu is about 550 kcal. Nasi dagang is about 600 kcal, a difference of around 50 kcal.
Nasi kerabu has about 19 g fat, nasi dagang 24 g. Nasi dagang is cooked with santan, so its fat is higher.
Nasi kerabu has about 25 g protein compared to 22 g. More protein usually helps you stay full longer.
Ulam and kerabu fill up your plate without many calories. This makes you eat more slowly.
when_a: Nasi dagang suits a weekend breakfast or a trip back to the kampung. Choose ikan tongkol (tuna) and go easy on the gulai gravy.
when_b: Nasi kerabu suits a normal lunch. Ask for more ulam and less kuah tumis or budu, to your taste.
tip: Whichever you choose, ask for grilled fish or chicken, go easy on the santan gravy, and drink plain water or teh o kosong (black tea, no sugar).

faq.a: It depends on the dishes. If you pick spiced fried chicken and lots of kerisik, the calories can go above nasi dagang.

faq.q: Can I eat nasi dagang while trying to lose weight?
faq.a: Yes. Eat a normal plate, don't add more rice, and make sure your other meals that day are lighter.
